meaning: Observed producer/consumer boundaries, never permission, semantic memory use, independent task verdict or causal credit.
unknown: All unsupported actual_use/task_success/causal_contribution facts remain null; prior_path never establishes current-cycle delivery. Reader byte acknowledgement means explicit exact-byte receipt, not cognitive reading.
sequence: Bounded local cycle record ordinal, not durable accepted sequence or chronology from sorted timestamps.
publication: Existing completed trace/source API stores metadata; existing TraceReceipt and reference-only spool carry canonical pointers. New payload has no retrieved claim and cannot create memory qualification.
packing: Only fresh final selected full/meta refs enter current cycle delivery. Dropped items and previous receipts never become same-reader current-cycle inclusion. Other paths separately observed.
retry: same cycle/event_id + identical sealed payload is no-op; conflicting payload rejected; new cycle cannot inherit prior completion

limits.runner_cycles: Explicit MaxCycles 1..256 mandatory when runner collector enabled; pending reservations and in-flight boundaries count; no premature Freeze.

source_hash_meaning: content_sha256 is exact text bytes at that stage when recorded (null if absent), provenance_sha256 fingerprints the actual returned record/response or prior typed receipt. A returned snippet and a later full-body read remain separate representations.
stage_meaning: server_return=context_usage/Search response; final_render=actual emitted input envelope; reader_bytes_acknowledged=exact-byte transport receipt; source_read=separate actual reader HTTP body read (not cognitive use); answer_observed=separately observed output bytes. Separate ChainPublication canonical_receipt_stored/canonical_receipt_readback fields acknowledge audit-receipt persistence, never relabelled memory store/model read.
canonical_time_codec: Existing trace transport-container timestamps are exact milliseconds as required by traceTime; original source ObservedAtNS remains unchanged inside the metadata payload.

storage_envelope.identity: canonical trace key is stable(scope,reader,cycle,page), never payload hash; first durable page binds entire frozen bundle SHA/count to reject changed-payload replay or append. Existing trace RequestHash/CAS refusal is reused unchanged.

collection_complete: No local admission/sink errors or pending boundaries. It is not lifecycle completion; Assess reports each missing stage unknown and all unsupported semantic verdicts null.
source_read_paths: prompt reads require same-reader delivered ref/revision. reader_direct is separate evidence and cannot become prompt inclusion; other hidden paths remain unmeasured.
canonical_acknowledgements: The existing TraceReceipt pointers are returned in ChainPublication, outside immutable runtime observation records. No self-claimed storage stages or duplicate authority DTO.
